answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not minted once and kept, it erodes each epoch like a quill running dry unless refreshed by genuine work. A fake farm can flash across the mesa for a moment, but every idle clone's weight dulls from quartz-bright to nothing the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts productively busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
